sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Back Door is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Word reached me that there's some kind of underground exit at the Reserve military base. Doesn't sound all that unusual on its own, except it has to be activated from the outside. From where exactly? That's what I need you to figure out. That extraction would be extremely useful to me. Reserve is full of military equipment that could come in handy for my work. I'd rather not send my own people - they're not as well prepared as you are. Find out how the extraction works, then come back and tell me. Your payment will be waiting."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate the secret underground bunker exit on Reserve
  - (Optional) Locate the switch that activates the exit
- Survive and extract from the location through the secret exit

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.75
- 275,000 Roubles
  - 288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"You managed to activate the door? Excellent. Here's your payment, just as promised."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
This quest requires you to extract with the "D-2" extraction on Reserve.

First, turn on the power with a lever in the command part of the underground bunker system. Be aware, activating the lever has the chance to spawn Scav Raiders in the command part of the bunker. Then, press the button on the wall next to the sliding door at the extraction. You need to exit the raid with the "Survived" status to get the quest completion. The "Run Through" status will not complete the quest. To avoid the "Run Through" status, gain at least 200 EXP in raid (by killing or looting) or be in raid for at least 7 minutes before extracting.
